items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It’s in something that Stravinsky said.

ctx.x: So, it started in the 50’s, and um...by going to the Manhattan School in the 60’s it enhanced this germ that had been planted during the 50’s. Um...and as a result of this, I found the few works that I’ve done for orchestra, um...that when you listen to them plated by the orchestra, at that time you, you relive the experiences that you had during the time that you actually composed the music and put the symbols on the score. Uh...maybe I can elaborate on that more. It’s in something that Stravinsky said. He said,…
